note: Literature establishes KDM2B-related disorder (OMIM #621474) as presenting with core neurodevelopmental delay across all individuals, with variable congenital heart defects (around 50-78%) and less frequent renal/urogenital anomalies.

evidence.text: In individuals with KDM2B CxxC variants, developmental delay was observed in all patients, while congenital heart defects were found in up to 78%, accompanied by variable urogenital and ophthalmological findings.

source.title: KDM2B variants in the CxxC domain impair its DNA-binding ability and cause a distinct neurodevelopmental syndrome
source.quote: All individuals with CxxC variants presented with developmental delay, mainly in the speech and motor domain, in addition to variable intellectual disability and mild facial dysmorphism. Congenital heart defects were observed in up to 78% of individuals, with additional common findings including musculoskeletal, ophthalmological, and urogenital anomalies, as well as behavioral challenges and feeding difficulties.

evidence.text: The discovery cohort established that heterozygous (likely) pathogenic KDM2B variants present with developmental delay and/or intellectual disability along with variable congenital organ anomalies predominantly of the heart, eyes, and urogenital system.

source.title: Delineation of a KDM2B-related neurodevelopmental disorder and its associated DNA methylation signature
source.quote: Our efforts resulted in a cohort of 21 individuals with heterozygous (likely) pathogenic variants. Individuals in this cohort present with developmental delay and/or intellectual disability; autism; attention deficit disorder/attention deficit hyperactivity disorder; congenital organ anomalies mainly of the heart, eyes, and urogenital system; and subtle facial dysmorphism.
